findings: "https://github.com/BrianMills2718/project-meta/issues/1985#issuecomment-6072216350" — contains a real-person GitHub account identifier (BrianMills2718).
rationale: The plan otherwise contains permitted local paths, repository/commit/control-session identifiers, sanitized runtime findings, and project-control documentation. The GitHub username is an account detail and is therefore private under the screening rules.
